items.name: boot-recovery
items.title: Power-loss / reboot auto-start
items.check: macos: launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.forgefleet.forgefleetd; linux: systemctl --user is-enabled forgefleetd && loginctl show-user $USER -p Linger --value = yes

install.macos: bootstrap template renders ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.forgefleet.forgefleetd.plist + com.forgefleet.forgefleet-mcp.plist (RunAtLoad + KeepAlive); headless Macs ALSO need Automatic login (System Settings → Users & Groups) — LaunchAgents fire at login, not at power-on
install.linux: sudo loginctl enable-linger $USER && systemctl --user enable forgefleetd.service forgefleet-mcp.service

items.update: ff converge re-verifies + re-arms daily (boot recovery section); runtime crashes are covered by local_healer's 30s tick
items.notes: Added 2026-08-06 after a site power loss: vinny recovered via launchd, james crash-looped then stabilized, duncan+sophie stayed dark (needed physical check). local_healer restarts a crashed daemon but only runs once something started it after boot — this item guards THAT enrollment layer.

items.name: power-recovery
items.title: Power-loss auto power-on (BIOS AC-restore + Wake-on-LAN)
items.check: linux: ethtool $(ip route show default | awk '{print $5}' | head -1) | grep 'Wake-on: g' (+ this node's MAC present in computers.mac_addresses); macos: pmset -g | grep 'womp 1'

install.linux: bootstrap template WoL step: apt-get install -y ethtool && ethtool -s <iface> wol g, persisted across reboots by /etc/systemd/system/forgefleet-wol.service (oneshot, multi-user.target)
install.windows: NIC driver properties → Power Management → 'Wake on Magic Packet' (+ powercfg /waketimers as needed)

items.update: ff converge re-verifies WoL daily (power section); BIOS AC-restore verified once at onboarding
items.notes: REQUIRES a one-time PHYSICAL BIOS step per machine — it cannot be flipped from the OS: set 'Restore on AC Power Loss → Power On' (GMKtec: Advanced → ACPI Settings; most AMI/Award BIOSes similar) and enable 'Wake on LAN / Wake on PCIe'. WoL is the fleet's remote fallback: the leader's revive_scan sends magic packets (revive::send_wol) to computers.mac_addresses when SSH is unreachable. Added 2026-08-07 after the 2026-08-06 site power loss left duncan + sophie dark (BIOS defaulted to Power Off, WoL never enabled at the OS level).
